name: Space Co.,Ltd.
summary: Space Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the planning, design, supervision, and construction of commercial facilities in Japan. The company's commercial facilities include shopping centers, department stores, specialty stores, and restaurants. It is also involved in the planning, design, supervision, and construction of museums and other cultural, sports, and entertainment facilities, as well as urban development, regional development, and environmental improvement projects; and planning, design, production, sale, and import and export of exhibition equipment and display fixtures, indoor and outdoor decorative items, and furniture.
